description: Use this when the user wants a marketing audit of a public website, especially a B2B, manufacturer, exporter or service-business site: technical SEO, mobile performance (Google PageSpeed Insights), lead conversion (quote/contact forms, calls to action, click-to-call), trust signals (references, certifications, privacy policy, cookie consent), analytics and ad tracking tags, and language versions for target export markets. It fetches only the given page plus robots.txt and the sitemap, honors robots.txt, and returns category scores and prioritized fixes in English. Results for the same page are cached for up to 6 hours. Do not use it for AI crawler or AI search questions (use check_ai_search_readiness), for pages behind a login, or to monitor sites the user is not evaluating.

include_performance.description: Run the Google PageSpeed Insights mobile test (adds up to 30 seconds). Defaults to true.

target_languages.description: Optional ISO 639-1 codes of the languages the business sells in, e.g. ["en","de","ar"]. Used to check for matching language versions. Defaults to ["en"].

url.description: Public website address to check, for example "example.com" or "https://www.example.com/en/". Only this page is analyzed, plus the site’s robots.txt and sitemap.

name: audit_website
title: Audit a website for B2B marketing
